title: CRISPR Editing of Immortalized Cells with RNPs using Lipofection
author: Synthego
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uibeuan

steps.title: Seed cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Seed cells in the appropriate vessel and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until they reach 30–70 % confluence (Day 2).

steps.title: Dilute sgRNA and Cas9
steps.instruction: Dilute sgRNA and Cas9 nuclease to a final concentration of 3 µM (3 pmol µl⁻¹). If the stocks are 30 µM, perform an additional 10‑fold dilution.

steps.title: Assemble RNP complexes
steps.instruction: In a microcentrifuge tube (Tube 1), combine sgRNA and Cas9 at the recommended 1.3:1 molar ratio (sgRNA:Cas9) using the per‑reaction volumes from the table, then incubate 5–10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Lipofectamine solution
steps.instruction: In a second microcentrifuge tube (Tube 2), dilute Lipofectamine CRISPRMAX reagent in Opti‑MEM I Reduced Serum Medium according to the per‑reaction amounts listed in the table.

steps.title: Incubate transfection reagent
steps.instruction: Incubate the Lipofectamine‑Opti‑MEM mixture for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Combine RNP and Lipofectamine
steps.instruction: Add the contents of Tube 2 directly to Tube 1, mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down, and incubate 5–10 min at room temperature (do not exceed 30 min). Synthego recommends reverse transfection (add RNP mix to wells first, then cells).

steps.title: Optional suspension‑cell preparation
steps.instruction: For suspension cells, resuspend the cell pellet in growth medium, mix well, wash cells with enough 1X PBS to cover the well bottom, aspirate PBS, and skip the trypsin steps; proceed to cell counting.

steps.title: Detach adherent cells with trypsin
steps.instruction: Add enough trypsin to cover the bottom of each well, incubate 5 min in a humidified 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator, then neutralize by adding an equal volume of growth medium.

steps.title: Collect and count cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.42–1.2 × 10⁵ cells per reaction into a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 200 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µl of growth medium.

steps.title: Add RNP‑transfection mix to cells
steps.instruction: Add the RNP‑Lipofectamine mixture to each well of a 24‑well tissue‑culture plate, add the 500 µl cell suspension, and mix by pipetting as described in the table.

steps.title: Incubate transfected cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 2–3 days in a humidified 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Analyze editing efficiency
steps.instruction: Perform PCR, Sanger sequencing, and ICE analysis (or alternative NGS, FACS, functional assays) to assess editing. Optionally split cells into two groups—one for analysis and one for continued culture/storage.
